chunks: A number of our companions, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ali ibn al-Hakam, from Ibn Bukayr, from Zurara, who said:
Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) said: The Ordainment is during the night of the 19th, and the Confirmation is during the night of the 21st, and the accomplishment is during the night of the 23rd.
ai.seo_question: What are the three stages of divine decree on the nights of Laylat al-Qadr according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This narration from al-Kafi, transmitted through the chain of Zurarah, establishes a hierarchical framework for divine decree during the final ten nights of Ramadan, a view widely accepted in Shia jurisprudence. It distinguishes between the initial determination of affairs (al-taqdir) on the 19th, their confirmation (al-ibrām) on the 21st, and their final execution (al-imdā') on the 23rd, reflecting the gradual unfolding of God's will. This tripartite structure underscores the spiritual significance of these nights as periods where cosmic destinies are actively shaped and sealed.
